capabilities: show full vault-relative paths in tab labels
disambiguation: Not a file browser or path-copying tool; it only changes what tab labels display.
extras: README is a single descriptive sentence with no usage details, settings or screenshots.
problem: Tabs show only the file name, so files with the same name in different folders are hard to tell apart.
summary: Tab label modifier that makes each tab show the full vault-relative file path instead of the bare file name.
